classification: Finite authenticated-plant simulation holdout fixed without R25 candidate output; not a safety, hardware, hidden-production, or original-demo qualification.

qualification.incumbent_safety_floor: Preserve every strict R24 event and protected real-tool detection within five milliseconds, with no new false rise, duplicate, tail, or strict-duration cost.
qualification.positive_qualification: Long-single twins require exactly one quiet rise; actual double twins require two separately attributable quiet rises including the quick second; absolute misses remain reported even when the incumbent also misses.
qualification.real_contact: Verified tool contact is a protected true event and excluded from spurious-alarm accounting.

gates: executable plan, variable-force runner, evaluator, and protocol compiled and dry-validated before R25 candidate output
exactly 198 complete episodes across three mechanically distinct authentic-plant variants
force-free, long-single, only-first, only-second, and both twins are matched for every double case
signed per-tick first, second, committed, and scalar force records equal the registered variable-duration profiles
physical traces are bit-exact across arms within every twin
real tool contact is protected rather than counted as spurious
no candidate false rise, duplicate event rise, stuck tail, strict-duration cost regression, or incumbent strict loss
one quiet rise for every long single and each actual double impulse, including the quick second
all absolute misses and positive gains are reported separately from incumbent safety preservation
no tuning, fallback, threshold, cohort, force, mechanics, scoring, or gate change after outcomes
